title: nextbrief brief.json -- stage 2 output
description: The only artifact the interpretation stage produces. The renderer re-checks every evidence entry; anything it cannot resolve is not rendered.

next_actions.description: At most 3 across the WHOLE portfolio, not 3 per project. Overflow goes to log/deferred.jsonl.

project_lines.description: One plain-language line per project. Neutral tone: no praise, no scolding.

next.description: What to show in the 'next' column

agent_queue.description: Items with blocked_by=agent or automation.tier=hook. At most 3.

waiting_for.description: Items with blocked_by=external-party or approval. At most 5.

delegated.description: Projects that publish their own daily entry point: a count and a link, never a restatement of their contents. Key is the project id.

decision_notes.description: For projects with blocked_by=decision: what evidence would settle the question and whether it is already at hand. Never a nudge to hurry.

suggestions.description: Proposals addressed to the human, e.g. 'consider adding date X to registry.deadlines'. The agent must never add a deadline itself.

new_backlog_items.description: Ids of items created this run. At most 5 per run, and none at all once the 40-item hard ceiling is reached.

kind.description: Confidence order commit > session > file_mtime > doc_declared. The brief must name the kind, because a commit and a file timestamp do not mean the same thing.

source.description: Must already exist as a key in snapshot.evidence_index. Unresolvable source -> the whole claim is dropped, not softened.

evidenceList.description: kind=none may only carry the configured 'no signal' phrasing. When there is no evidence, say that -- do not invent some.

title.description: A concrete physical action, not a goal

why.description: What it costs to not do it

evidence_line.description: Human-readable evidence summary as rendered into the brief

non_goal_flag.description: Filled in by the renderer when an action collides with a declared non-goal. The model must not set this.
